name: n8n-production-hardening
description: Production-hardening reference for n8n workflows: authenticated ingress, exactly-once processing, dead-lettering, and a static workflow linter.

scripts.wf:run: docker compose -f deployment/docker-compose.yml --env-file .env exec -e N8N_RUNNERS_BROKER_PORT=5680 -T n8n n8n execute
